problems.memo_sentence: The main acknowledged limitation of the quantum approach is that the VQNN exhibits overfitting when trained on the relatively large stock datasets, leading to less efficient and inconsistent performance across indices.
problems.source_evidence:
The VQNN model show the performance to predict the trend of the low stock price despite of being faster in learning, a smaller number of hidden neurons, and high speed in processing stock data, (Jeswal and Chakraverty, 2018). The model is encountered by overfitting of the stock data due to large data used during training and testing process, (Hirai, 2024).
...
The VQNN network had less efficiency and showed inconsistency in terms of performance indices due to the overfitting of stock datasets.
...
Though LSTM performed better, MLR has also produced good results in terms of the correlation coefficient and it is observed that the speed of computation is better with VQNN.
problems.explanation: The memo correctly notes overfitting and inconsistent performance as limitations but omits the explicitly stated compensating advantage that VQNN has better speed of computation and faster learning, which is part of the paper’s nuanced assessment of the quantum approach.

problems.memo_sentence: The authors motivate VQNNs by noting that quantum superposition and entanglement can, in principle, accelerate learning.
problems.source_evidence: Quantum operations are encoded and processed data into the quantum neural networks (QNNs), by employing quantum superposition, and entanglement which accelerate the learning process (Ciliberto et al., 2018).
problems.explanation: The acceleration claim is attributed in the paper to Ciliberto et al. (2018) as background, not presented as the authors’ own empirical motivation for this specific study. The memo slightly over-attributes this general literature claim to the authors’ reasoning for their concrete VQNN design.

problems.memo_sentence: Overall, the authors conclude that MLR and LSTM networks were accurate for predicting low stock prices for both datasets, while VQNN results were less consistent.
problems.source_evidence:
Hence the MLR and LSTM networks were accurate in predicting the low stock price for CRDB and NMB datasets considered due to the presence of more additional layers and dropout layer which reduce generalization of the results.
...
The VQNN network had less efficiency and showed inconsistency in terms of performance indices due to the overfitting of stock datasets.
...
Though LSTM performed better, MLR has also produced good results in terms of the correlation coefficient and it is observed that the speed of computation is better with VQNN.
problems.explanation: The memo captures the main conclusion about accuracy and inconsistency but selectively omits the concurrent positive conclusion that VQNN has better computational speed, which slightly skews the overall takeaway about the quantum model.
